audit.why: 51.63% WR over 736 games for Naafiri. Assassin mirror the pack wins early; Qiyana takes over at 2+ items via the wall-stun combo. EVEN 5.5/10 fits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full chart carried a blanket 'Skill' on all seven rows; content and packet agree Naafiri levels 1 through first item, Qiyana at 2+ items. phases[6].why described Naafiri winning the stage the content gives Qiyana.
audit.why: Her only hard CC is the R shockwave (120s) which needs terrain to stun; in open lane the pack out-bodies her burst until item scaling flips the one-shot math.
audit.corrected: Sides aligned with matching ratings and rewritten whys where the verdict changed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content called Qiyana's ultimate 'Edge of Ixtal' twice — that is her empowered Q; the R is Supreme Display of Talent (same class of error as the calibration examples). It also claimed her W is a 'dash-shield' — kit W is a dash plus element enchant, no shield. Naafiri's dash again miscredited to W ('W-E onto her', 'W all-in', 'W (The Pack Hunts)'). Ten misgender hits — Qiyana is she/her.
audit.why: Kit and packet ability lists are authority. Her engage dash is E Audacity (11s down to 7) — the field the page already tracks.
audit.corrected: R name fixed, dash-shield claim removed, W/R slots corrected, pronouns fixed, real cooldowns added.
